profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Applied Materials
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer at Applied Materials
profile.summary:
•	Highly adaptable in quickly changing technical environments with very strong organizational and analytical skills
•	Work and communicate well with other engineers across all disciplines
•	Engineering software development, all layers, from embedded or drivers to middleware to user interfaces
•	Strong development and problem solving skills, work well with teams and very self motivated
•	.NET Framework, C/C++ programming language in Windows and in real-time operating systems
•	Good debugging skills with understanding of hardware/software interactions, computer architecture and operating systems fundamentals
•	Multi process and multi thread programming, interrupts, and assembly programming
•	User Interface, localization and internationalization design experiences
•	Managing requirements, engineering specifications, and project scheduling
•	Implementing software development life cycle policies and procedures 
•	Managing and supporting multiple projects 
•	Familiar with ClearCase source control tools and environment
•	Eclipse on Linux, Visual Studio IDE, TotalView debugger

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer at Applied Materials
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Applied Materials

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop and support software for  SEMI compliant Sabre Wafer Deposition tool
- Develop QNX RTOS software control 
- Provide support for SEC/GEM Factory Automation communication

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop, implement & debug Embedded software for  Linux high speed digital drivers controlling hardware in ATE testers.
•	Worked with proprietary high speed ASICS processing test patterns
•	Worked with in-house datalogging modules
•	Very familiar ClearCase for source control
•	Used TotalView for realtime debugging of codes
•	Use Eclipse for software development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contractor - Software Engineer 
•	Develop & debug wireless software for Intel wireless chips
•	Worked with Visual Studio C++ 2008
•	Used Win32 tools to track memory leaks and performance issues

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Electro Scientific Industries (ESI) – Portland OR March 1995 – Oct 2008
Principal Software Engineer 
•	Responsible for providing technical product roadmap for the business group.
•	Provided technical expert support for various products within the business group.
•	Managed and developed software for the new substrate scriber (24xx).
•	Supported ESI wafer trim system: XP porting, optimizing Windows/DSP communication, Ethernet sockets communication, and X/Y motion control system.
•	Architected and implemented the InTime Windows Real-Time extension OS (www.TenAsys.com ) onto Intel multi-core processors PC. InTime runs on one dedicated core, while Windows run on the other cores. Architecture removed the needs for expensive DSP controllers.

      Trim Group Software Engineering Manager 1999 – 2002
•	Managed 6-8 software engineers and several contractors.
•	Track bugs and manage software releases using Microsoft SourceSafe version control.
•	Worked with marketing and manufacturing to coordinate requirements and production.

      R&D Senior Software Engineer 1996 - 1999
•	Architected and implemented a high speed chip resistor (23xx) laser trimmer. 
o	System was a Host/Test design using Windows XP host running a GUI, implemented with MFC, controlling a quad-DSP real-time control system. Windows tools used: Visual Studio C++ 6.0 & Visual Studio .NET 2003. 
o	Worked with hardware engineers to define the DSP memory and I/O architecture. Implemented high speed communications between DSPs and Windows, 10 KHz servo loop to XY galvo scanners, and high speed digital/analog trim logic.
o	Used TI Code Composer to debug DSP codes via JTAG ports.
o	Worked with measurement system processing 8/16 bits A/D 
o	Internationalized software in 3 languages by converting entire code base to UNICODE.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- R&D Software Engineer
 o Written and support interactive compiler
 o Designed and implemented screen editor
 o Designed and implemented DOS files system driver on VME bus system
 o Designed and implemented Laser Trim and Measurement system software
 o Created UNIX productivity tools
 o Wrote Embedded software and bring up VME control boards
